statuses.mismatch: the spread exceeds the tolerance; the run exits non-zero and the row is not citable
statuses.ok: every answering system returned the same count
statuses.ok-deviation: the counts differ, but the relative spread (max - min) / max is within the tolerance; the `count-mismatch: ...` detail stays in `notes` and the run does not fail

execution.postgresql_planner_thresholds: parallel_setup_cost and min_parallel_table_scan_size are left at their defaults under both configurations
execution.postgresql_session_resolved_note: read back from each benchmark session while that configuration was live; `max_worker_processes` is the cluster-wide pool that bounds how many workers a query actually receives
execution.read_tier: every read scenario is measured under BOTH configurations; CSV `notes` carry threads=<name>
execution.write_tier: measured once, under the single configuration, after every read row

ingest.caveat: Ingest timings are context only and are NOT comparable across systems. Encoding a CityParquet package and populating an indexed relational schema are different operations; this benchmark is scoped to steady-state query performance.

memory_measurement.cityparquet: fresh reader child process; includes its idle baseline
memory_measurement.duckdb: process executing the embedded engine; includes its idle baseline
memory_measurement.postgresql: query backend PID; excludes other backend, background-worker, and idle-server processes; mapped shared pages can contribute to RSS; blank if procfs namespace mapping cannot be verified. Under the `parallel` configuration only the LEADER backend is sampled, so any worker's resident memory is excluded

cjdb.patch_summary: get_ground_surfaces() retains tied-Z footprint faces; the CityJSONSeq importer also streams input and uses 5,000-row INSERT batches. Object batches share cjdb's original object transaction; relationship batches remain deferred until all objects are present. See vendor/cjdb/README.md.

temporary_storage.description: Per-run scratch directories are under host_tmpdir; PostgreSQL containers receive separate /tmp binds, and DuckDB sets temp_directory explicitly.
